17:27 Local Time, 15:27 GMT, 20:57 IST: A convincing victory for Australia in the end as they bowl out Zimbabwe for 235 to take a 1-0 lead in the series! Chasing 295 was always going to be a steep hill to climb against this potent Australian attack. Zimbabwe did show great fight through a resilient partnership between Sikandar Raza and skipper Craig Ervine, but once that stand was broken, the innings unravelled rapidly. Australia squeezed the scoring in the middle overs and never let the hosts back into the contest. Star of the show was Nathan Ellis, who put in a sensational performance to register career-best ODI figures of 5 for 31. He was backed up brilliantly by the rest of the unit to seal a 59-run win. Earlier in the day, it was Matt Renshaw's fine century and Cooper Connolly's handy fifty that set up this massive total. A complete all-round performance from the visitors.
